reviews.title: Purple reign
reviews.comment: Beautiful purple pc case. Rare color which I was looking for to build my sister in law a gaming pc, with purple being her favorite color. Unique and just different enough from the majority of cases to not be boring.

reviews.title: Good case but has its problems
reviews.comment: Very easy access but i dont like that the motherboard is tuned funny all wires will come out the top
reviews.author: DavidH

reviews.title: Great looking case bit too small
reviews.comment: Great case overall. Has great airflow. Wish there were better channels for cables to the motherboard and power supply.
reviews.author: StephanieS

reviews.title: Love this case dont regret it a bit.
reviews.comment: [Employee of bestbuy] The case is super nice and clean, is pretty big (ATX full sized). It is screwless pretty much so you dont have to mess with the outside very much. It hides the wires incredibly well, but that also means its harder to switch cables out, mainly the pluggins when you install the motherboard because they will be faced towards the top of the case; you NEED to remove the top of the case or the back or both to repluggin stuff, kinda annoying but its a really good case regardless, tons of room, great price/design and color.
reviews.author: Jessica

reviews.title: Amazing Case
reviews.comment: The case it self looks outstanding in my opinion, then again I do like weird not ordinary things, it has great air intake I have a Ryzen 7 7700 CPU with a 4070 Super got a total of 8 fans technically 11 if you count the 3 fans for the CPU liquid cooling radiator, 5 fans for air intake and 3 fans for air outake they all fit I even have space for more fans I dare say like 4 more fans if I wanted but not needed as with my current set up and running games like call of duty in high graphics, Expedition 33 in ultra graphics, Assasins Creed Shadows in high graphics the temp goes up to 65 celcius but no higher than that in my CPU the GPU goes up to 56 celcius and not anything higher, so if your looking for a nicer case and not just an ordinary one this one is worth it, I suggest you get it.
reviews.author: MrArielS
